question.instructions: The agent's action reuses an existing repair, fix or implementation from one place in another.

criteria.true: Porting, mirroring or copying a specific existing fix, file, table or implementation into a different file, module, repository, language or framework
criteria.false: New code, a fix made in place, reading, running or committing without reusing a specific implementation from elsewhere

calibration.heldOut: Thresholds chosen on batch 1 (caught 7/8, false alarms 2/137) and checked on held-out batch 2: caught 20/22, false alarms 2/80. Random 100 actions: 4% prevalence, false alarms 2/90.
calibration.evidence: 2026-10-25 calibration of 261 personal-repo Claude Code actions; labels provisional except 15 user-reviewed disagreements; jev-1.14.0.
